picks.title: Spotify pulled 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations
picks.rationale: Spotify has disclosed a new figure: more than 50 million AI slop and spam tracks pulled from recommendations this year, though it still does not label AI tracks. That shapes discoverability for every release on the platform.
picks.excerpt: Spotify says it has pulled more than 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations this year — but it still isn't labeling AI tracks.

picks.title: Believe, TuneCore Artists Can Opt Into Spotify's AI Remix Tool
picks.rationale: This is a new licensing deal that lets indie artists opt in and earn royalties when fans make AI remixes and covers on Spotify. It is a concrete consent-and-pay model for derivative AI works.
picks.excerpt: A new licensing agreement lets participating Believe and TuneCore artists opt in to earn royalties from AI-powered fan remixes and covers on Spotify.

picks.title: Session Loops releases PitchNet, a free AI vocal pitch editor
picks.rationale: This is a free, cross-platform vocal pitch editor in the style of Melodyne. It uses AI resynthesis to rebuild the vocal at the edited pitch, and producers can use it right away.
picks.excerpt: PitchNet is a free Melodyne-style vocal pitch editor for macOS, Windows and Linux that shows notes in a piano roll and uses AI resynthesis to rebuild the vocal at the edited pitch for smoother, more natural results.

picks.title: 'Human Made, Human Paid': The Largest U.S. Musicians Union Is Demanding AI Protections
picks.rationale: The AFM has launched a new campaign demanding AI protections and pay in its contract with the major labels. It is a labor push separate from the court fight over the 'new use' clause.
picks.excerpt: The AFM's 'Human Made, Human Paid' campaign asks major labels to give musicians a contract with AI protections and compensation.

picks.title: Just 4 Noise launches ethically-trained AI kick-drum generator
picks.rationale: This is a new kick-drum generator trained only on licensed material. It is a practical sound-design tool and part of a growing set of ethically trained AI tools for producers.
picks.excerpt: Just 4 Noise's Just 4 Kicks is an AI kick-drum sample generator trained on licensed material, part of a wider trend of ethically-trained AI tools for producers.
